_comment: Executable contract for the mid-turn follow-up (steer) frame — what a message typed while an agent turn runs looks like on the wire, and how the user's words are recovered from a Hermes tool row or a pending_steer. Consumed by BOTH platforms' tests (Swift: scripts/SteerContractTest.swift via scripts/test-attach-note.sh; Kotlin: android app unit test HermesSteerTest). `{frame}` in a case stands for the `frame` value below. Any change to HermesSteer.swift / HermesSteer.kt must keep every case green on both sides.
frame:
<cuate-addendum>
The user is adding to the request you are working on right now: take the addition below into account in the current cycle.
</cuate-addendum>

framed.name: plain
framed.text: И по этим тоже интересует стендбай и прайм режим
framed.wire:
{frame}
